raw_segments.text: Perhaps, however, you devoutly believe in the devil and imagine to shift the question
that he may assist his votaries.
But if really respecting the power of such a being, an enemy to goodness and to God,
can you go to church after having been under such an obligation to him?
From these delusions to those still more fashionable deceptions, practiced by the whole
tribe of magnetizers, the transition is very natural.
With respect to them, it is equally proper to ask women a few questions.
